name: Uig
method: tidetimes.org.uk Uig vs its own Ullapool (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Ullapool: median time difference, least-squares height fit
note: HW and LW heights each = offset + scale * Ullapool (tidetimes: Loch Snizort (Uig Bay)). HW comes 16 min earlier than LW relative to Ullapool; 6% of events drop as a different turn. Heights follow tidetimes, Ullapool's Z0 is set to UKHO's level. Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Uig vs Ullapool, 2025-10-01 to 2026-11-22 (every 3 day(s), 511 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
